title: Silver Sigil
description: This resource pack is replacing the classic Totem of Undying with more suiting one.
body: This resource pack is replacing the classic Totem of Undying with more suiting one to Minecraft. Instead of various gold colours the new Totem of Undying has various silver colours and instead of green eyes there are red eyes. This resource pack does not change anything else besides the Totem of Undying texture.
